+name: Build Android5-6 Compatible APK
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    # 双播放器版本矩阵：1.4.1=安卓5原生EXO，1.11.1=安卓6+最新版(低版本回退IJK)
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        media3_ver: ["1.4.1", "1.11.1"]
+    # Chaquopy 15.0.1 + pyquery==2.0.2 需要 Python 3.8，Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 已无 3.8
+    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout (this repo)
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Verify minSdk adapted
+        run: |
+          echo "=== building media3 version: ${{ matrix.media3_ver }} ==="
+          grep -n "media3_version" player/build.gradle
+          echo "=== minSdk in app/flavors ==="
+          grep -n "minSdkVersion" app/build.gradle
+          echo "=== minSdk in player ==="
+          grep -n "minSdkVersion" player/build.gradle
+
+      - name: Inject release signing (V1+V2+V3+V4)
+        run: |
+          cp -f .github/workflows/TVBoxOSC.jks app/TVBoxOSC.jks
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          p='app/build.gradle'
+          s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
+          lines = [
+            'signingConfigs {',
+            'release {',
+            "storeFile file('TVBoxOSC.jks')",
+            "storePassword 'TVBoxOSC'",
+            "keyAlias 'TVBoxOSC'",
+            "keyPassword 'TVBoxOSC'",
+            'v1SigningEnabled true',
+            'v2SigningEnabled true',
+            'enableV3Signing true',
+            'enableV4Signing true',
+            '}',
+            '}',
+          ]
+          block = chr(10).join(lines)
+          indented = chr(10).join('    ' + x for x in lines)
+          s = s.replace('android {', 'android {' + chr(10) + indented, 1)
+          s = s.replace(
+            'release {' + chr(10) + '            minifyEnabled true' + chr(10) + '        }',
+            'release {' + chr(10) + '            minifyEnabled true' + chr(10) + '            signingConfig signingConfigs.release' + chr(10) + '        }',
+            1)
+          open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
+          print('injected signing config')
+          PY
+          echo "RELEASE_STORE_FILE=./TVBoxOSC.jks" >> gradle.properties
+          echo "RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=TVBoxOSC" >> gradle.properties
+          echo "RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=TVBoxOSC" >> gradle.properties
+          echo "RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=TVBoxOSC" >> gradle.properties
+          sed -i 's/^#\(org.gradle.jvmargs=.*\)/\1/' gradle.properties
+
+      - name: Setup Java 17
+        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: '17'
+
+      - name: Setup Gradle
+        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Python 3.8 (Chaquopy 15.0.1 requires it)
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.8'
+
+      - name: Prepare Python 3.8 for Chaquopy
+        run: |
+          python3.8 -m pip install --upgrade "pip==21.1.1" setuptools wheel
+
+      - name: Verify Android SDK (preinstalled on runner)
+        run: |
+          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
+          ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/platforms/* 2>/dev/null || true
+          ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/* 2>/dev/null || true
+          test -n "$ANDROID_HOME" || { echo "FATAL: no ANDROID_HOME"; exit 1; }
+
+      - name: Build all release APKs (java + python flavors)
+        run: |
+          echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_HOME" > local.properties
+          PY38=$(python3.8 -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)")
+          echo "buildPython -> $PY38"
+          sed -i "s#buildPython(\".*\")#buildPython(\"$PY38\")#" pyramid/build.gradle
+          # 源码包里的本地 wheel 要求 Python>=3.10，但 Chaquopy 15.0.1 锁 3.8，
+          # 换成 PyPI 上兼容 3.8 的版本（bs4 API 完全兼容，爬虫功能不变）
+          sed -i 's#install "local_wheels/beautifulsoup4-4.15.0-py3-none-any.whl"#install "beautifulsoup4==4.12.3"#' pyramid/build.gradle
+          sed -i 's#install "local_wheels/soupsieve-2.10-py3-none-any.whl"#install "soupsieve==2.5"#' pyramid/build.gradle
+          grep -n "install" pyramid/build.gradle
+          chmod +x gradlew
+          set -o pipefail
+          # 全量二合一包：genericPython32 + genericPython64 两个 flavor（均内置 Python + 单架构）
+          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-build-cache --warning-mode all -Pmedia3Ver=${{ matrix.media3_ver }} 2>&1 | tee build.log
+          EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          echo "BUILD_EXIT=$EXIT"
+          test "$EXIT" -eq 0 || exit "$EXIT"
+          echo "=== verify linked media3 version from dependency tree ==="
+          ./gradlew :player:dependencies --configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath -Pmedia3Ver=${{ matrix.media3_ver }} 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:[0-9.]+" | head -1 || true
+          echo "=== verify Python runtime packaged (libpython + chaquo) ==="
+          PYAPK=$(find app/build/outputs/apk -name "*genericPython32-release*.apk" | head -1)
+          unzip -l "$PYAPK" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "libpython|chaquo|assets/chaquo" | head -8 || true
+
+      - name: Collect & verify APKs
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p apk-out
+          find . -name "*release*.apk" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
+            cp "$f" apk-out/
+          done
+          echo "=== built APKs ==="
+          ls -lh apk-out/
+          BT=$(ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/* | sort -V | tail -1)
+          echo "=== using build-tools: $BT ==="
+          echo "=== signing & minSdk check (apksigner) ==="
+          APKSIGNER="$BT/apksigner"
+          for a in apk-out/*.apk; do
+            echo "--- $(basename "$a") ---"
+            "$APKSIGNER" verify --verbose --print-certs "$a" 2>&1 | grep -i "signer\|scheme\|verified" | head -12
+          done
+          echo "=== manifest minSdk check (aapt) ==="
+          AAPT="$BT/aapt2"
+          for a in apk-out/*.apk; do
+            echo "--- $(basename "$a") ---"
+            "$AAPT" dump badging "$a" 2>/dev/null | grep -i "sdkVersion\|targetSdkVersion" | head -3
+          done
+
+      - name: Upload APKs
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: TVBox-APKs-media3-${{ matrix.media3_ver }}
+          path: apk-out/*.apk
+
+      - name: Create Release
+        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
+        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
+        with:
+          files: apk-out/*.apk

+name: Test
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: 0 13 1 * *
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      rebuild:
+        description: '忽略构建记录以重新构建'
+        required: false
+        type: boolean
+      donotpublish:
+        description: '构建后不提交发布新版'
+        required: false
+        type: boolean
+  push:
+    tags:
+      - 'v*'   # 当推送 v1.0, v1.1, v2.0 等 tag 时自动触发
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: write   # 允许创建 Release
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        include:
+          - userName: yjhua2005
+            repoName: TVBoxOS
+            branchName: main
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - name: Check New Commit
+        run: |
+          upStream=https://github.com/${{ matrix.userName }}/${{ matrix.repoName }}
+          echo "upStream=$upStream" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          commit=$(curl -sL $upStream/commits/${{ matrix.branchName }} |grep -o "/${{ matrix.userName }}/${{ matrix.repoName }}/commit/[a-z0-9]\+" |head -1 | cut -d\/ -f5)
+          if [[ -z "${commit}" ]]; then
+            commit=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ matrix.userName }}/${{ matrix.repoName }}/commits/${{ matrix.branchName }}?per_page=1" | jq -r '.sha' )
+          fi
+          if ! grep -q "$commit" README.md || [ "${{ inputs.rebuild }}" == "true" ]; then
+            echo "commit=$commit" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+            echo "commitS=${commit:0:7}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          fi
+          echo "commit=$commit"
+      - name: Checkout Source Code
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        run: |
+          git clone ${{ env.upStream }} TVBoxOSC
+          cd TVBoxOSC
+          git checkout ${{ env.commit }}
+          echo "tag=$(git log --date=format:'%Y%m%d-%H%M' --pretty=format:%cd ${{ env.commitS }} -1)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+      - name: Extra Modify
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        working-directory: TVBoxOSC
+        run: |
+          echo '修改VersionName'
+          if [ "${{ matrix.userName }}" == "takagen99" ]; then
+            sed -i 's/\.concat(buildTime())/ +\"${{ env.tag }}\"/g' app/build.gradle 
+            sed -i "/android:text=/s#=\"#=\"${{ env.tag }}\\\\n\\\\n#" app/src/main/res/layout/dialog_about.xml
+          else
+             sed -i "/versionName/s#[0-9a-zA-Z_\.\'\"-]\+\$#\'${{ env.tag }}\'#" app/build.gradle
+             sed -i "/android:text=/s#=\"#=\"${{ env.tag }}\\\\n\\\\n#" app/src/main/res/layout/dialog_about.xml
+          fi 
+          echo 'crosswalk源，防挂'
+          if grep -q 'crosswalk' build.gradle; then
+            sed -i "/crosswalk/a\        maven { url 'https://o0halflife0o.github.io/crosswalk/releases/crosswalk/android/maven2' }" build.gradle
+          else
+            sed -i "/jitpack.io/a\        maven { url 'https://o0halflife0o.github.io/crosswalk/releases/crosswalk/android/maven2' }" build.gradle
+          fi
+      - name: Compress Source Code
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        working-directory: TVBoxOSC
+        run: |
+          tar -cJf sourceCode-${{ env.commitS }}.tar.xz --exclude=.git --exclude=.github *
+      - name: Release Apk Sign
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        working-directory: TVBoxOSC
+        run: |
+          signingConfigs=''
+          signingConfig='ICAgICAgICAgICAgaWYgKHByb2plY3QuaGFzUHJvcGVydHkoIlJFTEVBU0VfU1RPUkVfRklMRSIpKSB7XAogICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgc2lnbmluZ0NvbmZpZyBzaWduaW5nQ29uZmlncy5teUNvbmZpZ1wKICAgICAgICAgICAgfVwK'
+          signingConfigs="$(echo "$signingConfigs" |base64 -d )"
+          signingConfig="$(echo "$signingConfig" |base64 -d )"
+          sed -i -e "/defaultConfig {/i\\$signingConfigs " -e "/debug {/a\\$signingConfig " -e "/release {/a\\$signingConfig " app/build.gradle
+          cp -f ${{ github.workspace }}/.github/workflows/TVBoxOSC.jks app/TVBoxOSC.jks
+          sed -i '$a\RELEASE_STORE_FILE=./TVBoxOSC.jks'     ./gradle.properties
+          sed -i '$a\RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=TVBoxOSC'            ./gradle.properties
+          sed -i '$a\RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=TVBoxOSC'       ./gradle.properties
+          sed -i '$a\RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=TVBoxOSC'         ./gradle.properties
+          sed -i 's/^#\(org.gradle.jvmargs=.*\)/\1/'        ./gradle.properties
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        if: ${{ matrix.java_ver }}
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: ${{ matrix.java_ver }}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+      - name: Setup Python 3.8
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.8'
+      - name: Build With Gradle
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        working-directory: TVBoxOSC
+        run: |
+          echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_HOME" > local.properties
+          echo '修改pyramid的Python路径'
+          sed -i "s#buildPython(\".*\")#buildPython(\"python3\")#" pyramid/build.gradle
+          chmod +x gradlew
+          python3.8 -m pip install pip==21.1.1 setuptools wheel
+          ./gradlew assemblerelease --build-cache --parallel --daemon --warning-mode all
+      - name: Prepare App
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        working-directory: TVBoxOSC
+        run: |
+          rm -rf apk/
+          mkdir -p apk/
+          for file in `find ~ -name "*release*.apk" -print`; do
+            base=$(basename "$file")
+            if [[ "$base" == TVBox_* ]]; then
+              new_base=$(echo "$base" | sed "s/release/${{ matrix.userName }}_${{ env.tag }}/")
+            else
+              new_base="TVBox_${{ matrix.userName }}_${{ env.tag }}.apk"
+            fi
+            mv "$file" "apk/$new_base"
+          done
+          mv sourceCode-${{ env.commitS }}.* apk/
+      - name: Release Note
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        working-directory: TVBoxOSC
+        run: |
+          lastCommit=$(grep "${{ matrix.userName }}\/${{ matrix.repoName }}" ${{ github.workspace }}/README.md |grep -o '[a-z0-9]\{40\}' || echo "")
+          export LESSCHARSET=utf-8
+          echo -e "Credit: [${{ matrix.userName }}](${{ env.upStream }})\nCommit: ${{ env.commit }}\nChangelog:\n\`\`\`" > apk/${{ matrix.userName }}-Release.log
+          if [ "${{ env.commit }}" == "${lastCommit}" ]; then
+            git log --pretty=format:%B ${{ env.commitS }} -1 |sed -e "s# \{2,\}#\n#g" -e "/^Merge \(pull\|branch\|remote\)/d" -e '/^$/d' |cat -n |sort -k2,2 -k1,1n |uniq -f1 |sort -k1,1n |cut -f2- >> apk/${{ matrix.userName }}-Release.log
+          else
+            git log --pretty=format:%B ${{ env.commitS }}...${lastCommit:0:7} |sed -e "s# \{2,\}#\n#g" -e "/^Merge \(pull\|branch\|remote\)/d" -e '/^$/d' |cat -n |sort -k2,2 -k1,1n |uniq -f1 |sort -k1,1n |cut -f2- >> apk/${{ matrix.userName }}-Release.log
+          fi
+          echo -e '\n```' >> apk/${{ matrix.userName }}-Release.log
+      - name: Upload App To Artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: ${{ env.commit }}
+        with:
+          name: ${{ matrix.userName }}-${{ matrix.repoName }}
+          path: |
+            TVBoxOSC/apk/*
+      # 新增：自动发布到 Releases（仅在 tag 触发时执行）
+      - name: Create Release and Upload APK
+        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
+        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') && env.commit != ''
+        with:
+          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
+          name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
+          body_path: TVBoxOSC/apk/${{ matrix.userName }}-Release.log
+          files: |
+            TVBoxOSC/apk/*.apk
+            TVBoxOSC/apk/*.tar.xz
+      - name: Whether Or Not to Publish
+        if: ${{ inputs.donotpublish && env.commit }}
+        run: |
+          echo "commit=" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+  clean:
+    needs: build
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Delete older workflow runs and artifacts
+        uses: Mattraks/delete-workflow-runs@main
+        with:
+          token: ${{ github.token }}
+          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
+          retain_days: 14
+          keep_minimum_runs: 10

+def appMinSdk = media3Ver == "1.4.1" ? 21 : 23
+
+android {
+    namespace 'com.github.tvbox.osc'
+    compileSdkVersion 36
+
+    // AGP 8.x 默认关闭 BuildConfig 生成，双版本标志 LEGACY_MEDIA3 需要显式开启
+    buildFeatures {
+        buildConfig true
+    }
+
+    defaultConfig {
+        applicationId 'com.github.tvbox.osc.jun'
+        targetSdkVersion 28
+        versionCode 1
+        versionName '1.0.0'
+        multiDexEnabled true
+        // 1.4.1 版 media3 原生支持 API19+，EXO 在安卓5可用；1.11.1 版要求 API23，低版本回退 IJK
+        buildConfigField "boolean", "LEGACY_MEDIA3", (project.findProperty("media3Ver") == "1.4.1").toString()
+        //设置room的Schema的位置
+        javaCompileOptions {
+            annotationProcessorOptions {
+                arguments = ["room.schemaLocation": "$projectDir/schemas".toString()]
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    packagingOptions {
+        exclude 'META-INF/DEPENDENCIES'
+        exclude 'META-INF/beans.xml'
+    }
+
+    // 全量二合一包：只保留 python32/python64 两个 flavor（均内置 Python 环境、按需加载）。
+    // 砍掉 java 系与 hisense 定制版，避免分发混乱与存储冗余。
+    // minSdk21：Chaquopy Python 运行时要求，覆盖安卓5.0+/6+/11+。

+    productFlavors {
+        generic {
+            dimension "brand"
+        }
+        python32 {
+            dimension "mode"
+            minSdkVersion appMinSdk
+            ndk {
+                //noinspection ChromeOsAbiSupport
+                abiFilters 'armeabi-v7a'
+            }
+            proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android-optimize.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro', 'proguard-rules-MoreSource.pro', 'proguard-python.pro'

+        }
+        python64 {
+            java.srcDirs += 'src/python/java'
+        }
+    }
+
+    buildTypes {
+        debug {
+            minifyEnabled false
+        }
+        release {
+            minifyEnabled true
+        }
+    }
+
+    // 禁用 ABI 分割
+    splits {
+        abi {
+            enable false // 禁用 ABI 分割
+        }
+    }
+
+    applicationVariants.configureEach { variant ->
+        variant.outputs.configureEach { output ->
+            def flavorNames = variant.productFlavors.collect { it.name }.join('-')
+            // 构建自定义文件名

+@Dao

+    /**
+     * 注意，冒号后面必须紧跟参数名，中间不能有空格。大于小于号和冒号中间是有空格的。
+     * select *from cache where【表中列名】 =:【参数名】------>等于
+     * where 【表中列名】 < :【参数名】 小于
+     * where 【表中列名】 between :【参数名1】 and :【参数2】------->这个区间
+     * where 【表中列名】like :参数名----->模糊查询
+     * where 【表中列名】 in (:【参数名集合】)---->查询符合集合内指定字段值的记录
+     *
+     * @param key
+     * @return
+     */
+
+    //如果是一对多,这里可以写List<Cache>
+    @Query("select *from cache where `key`=:key")
+    Cache getCache(String key);
+
+    //只能传递对象昂,删除时根据Cache中的主键 来比对的
+    @Delete
+    int delete(Cache cache);
+
+    //只能传递对象昂,删除时根据Cache中的主键 来比对的
+    @Update(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
